junior.title: Youth housing deposit facility
junior.hint: See what a youth housing deposit pays in and what facility it earns, or estimate your payments. This only calculates; nothing is requested from the bank.
junior.loadError: The table could not be loaded.
junior.finalRemain: Aggregate remaining at the end of each year (Rials)
junior.finalBody: Aggregate account body at the end of each deposit year (Rials)
junior.yearBody: Account body at the end of each deposit year, separately (Rials)
junior.averageBody: Average balance in each year, separately (Rials)
junior.note1: Average balance separately in each year is calculated using account body in each year divided by 12 (months).
junior.note2: Average balance with mentioned digits in the computer is a little bit different, because we are using a method for converting day count to month count.
junior.note3: Accrued facilities separately in each year is calculated using each year coefficient multiplied by its average balance.
junior.note4: Deposit coefficient is calculated using maximum facilities in each year divided by total accrued facilities (according to specified payments in monthly payment column).
junior.note5: Big cities consist of: Karaj, Mashhad, Tabriz, Isfahan, Ahvaz, Qom and Shiraz.
junior.lumpSumNote: The amount that has to be transferred in the opening year of the account and stays there until receiving of the facility.
junior.monthlyNote: The amount that has to be transferred, beginning of each month.
junior.annualNote: The amount that has to be transferred all together, beginning of each deposit year.
